summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares amivantamab plus mFOLFOX6 or FOLFIRI with cetuximab plus mFOLFOX6 or FOLFIRI as first-line treatment for unresectable or metastatic left-sided colorectal cancer in adults whose tumors are KRAS/NRAS and BRAF wild-type. Participants receive treatment in 28-day cycles and continue until radiographic disease progression or other discontinuation criteria are met; the route of administration is not stated. The study measures progression-free survival, meaning how long participants remain disease-free.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara amivantamab más mFOLFOX6 o FOLFIRI con cetuximab más mFOLFOX6 o FOLFIRI como tratamiento de primera línea para el cáncer colorrectal del lado izquierdo, no resecable o metastásico, en adultos con tumores de tipo silvestre para KRAS/NRAS y BRAF. Los participantes reciben el tratamiento en ciclos de 28 días y continúan hasta la progresión radiográfica de la enfermedad u otros criterios de suspensión; la vía de administración no se indica. El estudio mide la supervivencia libre de progresión, es decir, cuánto tiempo los participantes permanecen sin que la enfermedad avance.
who_for: Adenocarcinoma of left-sided colorectal cancer that is unresectable or metastatic.
KRAS, NRAS, and BRAF wild-type tumor, by local and/or central testing.
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 and ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
No prior systemic therapy for unresectable or metastatic colorectal cancer; adjuvant or neoadjuvant therapy allowed if completed over 12 months before recurrenc
not_for: History or current interstitial lung disease, pneumonitis, or pulmonary fibrosis.
Known allergy or intolerance to amivantamab, cetuximab, or components of the chemotherapy regimens.
Prior or current second malignancy that could interfere with study endpoints or treatment.
Known dMMR/MSI-H status or HER2-positive/amplified tumor.
Prior exposure to agents targeting EGFR, MET, or VEGF.
